title: The economics of global personality diversity
abstract: arXiv:2503.19388v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This study explores the relationship between personality diversity and national economic performance, introducing the Global Personality Diversity Index ($\Psi$-GPDI) as a novel metric. Leveraging a dataset of 760,242 individuals across 135 countries, we quantify within-country diversity based on the Big Five personality traits. Our findings reveal that personality diversity accounts for 19.9% of the variance in GDP per capita and provides an additional 5.7% explanatory power beyond institutional quality and immigration, underscoring its unique contribution to economic vitality. Through multi-factor analysis, we demonstrate how personality diversity complements existing economic frameworks, offering actionable insights for policymakers seeking to enhance innovation, productivity, and resilience. translated_title: 全球人格多样性的经济学
translated_abstract: 本研究探讨了人格多样性与国家经济表现之间的关系，并引入了一种新颖的度量指标——全球人格多样性指数（$\Psi$-GPDI）。利用涵盖135个国家、760,242名个体的数据集，我们基于大五人格特质量化了国内多样性。研究结果显示，人格多样性解释了人均GDP差异的19.9%，并且在制度质量和移民因素之外，额外提供了5.7%的解释力，凸显了其对经济活力的独特贡献。通过多因素分析，我们证明了人格多样性如何补充现有的经济框架，为寻求提升创新、生产力和韧性的政策制定者提供了可行的见解。这项研究将心理多样性定位为驱动经济增长的一个关键但尚未充分探索的因素，弥合了心理学与经济学的鸿沟。
tldr: 本研究首次提出全球人格多样性指数，并证明人格多样性在解释国家经济表现中具有显著且独立的贡献，为经济增长研究提供了新的心理维度视角。
en_tdlr: This study introduces the Global Personality Diversity Index and demonstrates that personality diversity significantly and independently explains national economic performance, offering a novel psychological dimension to economic growth research.
